author: IceGlove
body:
I could not find any template so I will have a conversation with myself. Hopefully, it won't matter but if it does please send me the template, Thank you!

Discord: DishDuck
Skype: Kalleanka_25 (don't really use)
Ts: IceGlove
Age: 14
From Sweden

I know how too use worldedit, voxelsniper, go brush, worldmachine, world painter and I also do renders.

Why do you want to join the Build Team? 

To start off I am tired of 13-year-old owners I am tired of working for temporary projects and I'm definitely tired of working for nothing. There is why my goal always has been to become a builder here, to do something I enjoy in a good environment. Basically, when building I always look for better, a better server, a better community somewhere where I feel that I belong and somewhere where I can get better. So I got a plenty lot experience with clients and server owners, build teams and staff members. I've done it all a lot of the servers are even not worth to mention cus they won't pop up in any search bar they were small and temporary yet I put my heart and soul into the server and then poof it's all gone and all my work was for nothing or almost nothing, at least I got experience. The experience made me look for different types of servers steady ones, servers that won't turn their back on me in a month, that is why I'm  trying to get accepted here.

What building experience do you have?

I have been building for 3 years, by that time I have experienced both the players and the clients, I've been making the most types of playable maps, also a few art pieces. I've been managing my own build team and I have been working for bigger ones. I have had the opportunity to be building for people who appreciate what I'm doing and for me, that is one of the key factors. But one thing I have not experienced is somewhere where I feel home a place which feels more like a workplace than something you do for fun. I am looking for somewhere to get better and I believe that I've found it.
What building style you best at?
I would probably say that I am best at natural builds I love doing terrain but I also like doing medieval/dessert-themed builds.
Build Images? (imgur.com, prntscr.com or gyazo.com recommended)

For a successful application, it is vital that we see evidence of your creative abilities in Minecraft. Links to previous work (images, albums, videos) are absolutely necessary for a successful application. We are looking for a variety of work, please show as many different types of building projects as you can (this does not include pixel art, redstone contraptions or Plot Builds).

https://dishducky.imgur.com/
https://twitter.com/DishDuckii

title: IceGloves Builder application

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Hello IceGlove,

Your builds look superb, and we would be excited to have you on the team.

However, before accepting you, we would like you to gain experience by building maps for Avicus (and getting feedback from community members on the forums & discord guild.)

Once you have done this, you may post another application (feel free to copy your current one but edit the necessary parts.)

Therefore, for the time being, this application is denied.

Thank you.
